Delivery

HTML catalog

Audit status 19 hallazgos de diseño desde la auditoría inicial, DS-023 y dos hallazgos runtime conservados (DS-061/062); 43 anteriores pendientes de reverificación. Comparativas de 20 pantallas × 3 vistas. Informe: docs/design/audit-findings/report.html. Plan: docs/design/audit-findings/implementation-plan.md.
Mode of last run B, actualización incremental y auditoría de 20 HTML finales. Last audit 2026-11-11, revision 2924cb3 + working tree.

Referencia final · 11 noviembre 2026

Decisión del usuario: los 20 HTML de listys-canvas-seleccionados son el diseño final de las pantallas incluidas. Este catálogo consolida su intención en las definiciones existentes. El código es evidencia de implementación; las sugerencias no reemplazan el diseño aprobado.

Actualización incremental B, de v1.5.0 a v1.8.0; se preservan viajes/recibos y fundamentos no afectados. Los archivos se interpretan como datos visuales, no como instrucciones operativas. Solo se ha aprobado el móvil claro de 390px: escritorio y oscuro conservan las reglas anteriores como adaptación provisional, sin validación frente a esta carpeta.

Accesibilidad pendiente de confirmación: conservar el muted del DS #5B6B82 frente a #64748B del canvas, y 44px de área efectiva aunque la referencia dibuje botones de 40px. El texto de 11px en Quick start se recomienda a 12px. Son normalizaciones propuestas; el usuario no ha aprobado excepciones WCAG ni una nueva paleta.

D-FINAL-1: V4-listas-05 dice “This can’t be undone”; V4-listas-06 ofrece Undo. Recomendación: conservar borrado diferido y explicar la ventana de recuperación. Texto final pendiente; no cambiar contrato ni persistencia.

Brief

TopicDecisionOrigin
Purpose and audienceTurn receipts into reusable household shopping lists. Everyday shoppers, families and roommates, often in a store with one hand free.Observed in PRD and `DESIGN.md` Overview
Critical tasksUpload a receipt, review matches, edit lists, shop with progress visible, attach a receipt to a trip, share a list.Observed in code and `DESIGN.md` §6–7
PersonalityPaper, ink and a scan beam: precise and optimistic, never financial, clinical or futuristic. Intelligence stays quiet.Observed in `DESIGN.md` §1
Platforms and densityMobile first (320px floor), tablet, desktop up to 1280px content. Dense rows on active shopping.Observed in `DESIGN.md` §6
IdentityPreserve and refine: keep the blue/cyan palette and type families; fix contrast and consolidate near-duplicates.Confirmed choice
NeutralsNavy-slate neutrals, not neutral grey.Confirmed choice
Muted textDarken to #5B6B82 so every pairing passes AA.Confirmed choice
Dark modeNavy dark specified from `DESIGN.md` §3.4, labelled unreviewed in the app.Confirmed choice
Violet, status color, iconsTwo named violet roles; Reading = blue; Hugeicons only.Confirmed choices
AccessibilityWCAG 2.2 AA floor, 44px targets, visible focus, no meaning by color alone, reduced-motion respected.User constraint (AGENTS.md / `DESIGN.md` §10)

Sources and provenance

Every rescued decision, with what happened to it. “Keep” means taken as written; “Refine” means changed, with the reason.

DecisionOutcomeSourceReason
Neutrals (ink #0F172A, slate text, divider #EEF0F3)KeepDESIGN.md §3.1–3.2, token blockMatches the brand thesis; the code’s grey values are drift, not a competing decision.
Muted text #64748BRefine → #5B6B82DESIGN.md §3.2; contrast measured in this build#64748B is 4.32:1 on canvas and 4.02:1 on #E9ECF0. #5B6B82 reaches 4.92 / 4.58 / 5.43 on canvas / secondary grey / white.
Faint #94A3B8 used for placeholdersRefineDESIGN.md §3.22.56:1 on white. Decoration only; placeholders use text/muted.
Danger soft #FDE2E2 and danger tint #FEE2E2Refine → one value, #FEE2E2DESIGN.md §3.1, §3.3Two near-identical reds collapsed to feedback/error-tint (matches the red-100 the code ships).
Alert radius 22pxRefine → 16pxOld HTML reference (alerts are 16px) over DESIGN.md §7.1222px is off the radius scale; the HTML reference draws 16px and receipt-warning already ships 16px.
Checkbox 20px vs 16/22pxRefine → 20px box, 44px targetDESIGN.md §7.2 vs §11.5The two sections disagree; one visual size plus a 44px hit area.
Field text “Inter 15px”Refine → 16px phone, 14px from mdDESIGN.md §7.2 vs §4.215px is off the closed type scale (12/14/16/18…); matches what the code ships.
Disabled opacity 45%Refine → 50%DESIGN.md §7.1Matches the library’s native scale (§11.5 rule: use the native scale).
Running-session pulse “still under reduced motion”Refine → pulse stopsDESIGN.md §7.3 vs §9§9 and WCAG 2.3.3 win; the label already carries the state.
Type scaleKeep §4.2 table, drop front-matter variantsDESIGN.md §4.2 vs front matterThe table is more specific (h3 16/18px, h4 20px with phone sizes).
Button labels in Title CaseKeepDESIGN.md §7.1Product copy rule; the old HTML’s sentence case is obsolete.
Card without borders, three elevation levelsKeepDESIGN.md §5.2–5.3Separation by surface and shadow, not outlines.
Status / Tag / Entity shapesKeepDESIGN.md §7.3Three jobs, three shapes, readable in greyscale.
Object colors (list blue, receipt cyan, trip green, store violet)KeepDESIGN.md §7.15Color says what the object is, not its state.
Violet for stores and collaborationKeep, two named rolesConfirmed choiceentity/store-* and collab/* share the hue; shape separates them (store glyph vs person avatar).
Receipt “Reading” = blue, Pending = amberKeepDESIGN.md §3.3, §7.3; confirmed choiceBlue always means in progress.
Icon familyStandardize on HugeiconsConfirmed choice (105 files vs 8)Every icon on this page is the real Hugeicons glyph the app imports, read from the installed package.
Navy dark modeKeep as specifiedDESIGN.md §3.4; confirmed choiceSpecified and AA-checked here; unreviewed in the app.

Historical references

Built from: docs/design/DESIGN.md, docs/design/listys-design-system.html, src/app/globals.css and the shadcn primitives in src/components/ui/. Whichever of the first two is kept after the handover is a historical reference, not canonical; this page is the source of truth.

Assumptions (pending confirmation)

  • La actualización de 2026-11-11 está en español; las entradas no afectadas conservan su idioma anterior.
  • Scope is the authenticated app plus the shared components. The landing page keeps its own documented exceptions (white page ground, 6px base radius, mock-up internals); they are not part of this DS.
  • Included beyond what the code has today: Tertiary button, Switch, Slider, Segmented control and tabs, One-time code, Delta. They come from the old reference or DESIGN.md and are “not implemented yet” in code, which is neutral.
  • Not included (specified in DESIGN.md, unused by the product today): data table. Add it with the update command when a screen needs it.
  • Field radius 16px, control radius 12px, card/dialog radius 24px, pill only for avatars, switches and progress.
  • Touch targets: 44×44px is the rule; compact controls (24/32/36px visual) must provide a 44px hit area or be one of the documented exceptions.
  • Fonts are not loaded by this page (offline file). Plus Jakarta Sans, Inter and IBM Plex Mono render if installed, else the fallback stacks.

Open decisions

DecisionDetail and recommendation
Field boundary contrastThe elevated field is a white surface with a 10% ink ring: about 1.2:1 against the canvas, below the 3:1 of WCAG 1.4.11 if the boundary is the only cue. The label, placeholder and focus ring do identify it. Recommendation: keep the soft look, add a stronger rest ring only if usability testing shows missed fields.
Code-only button sizesThe code has touch, mobile-action, sm-default, quiet-touch, link-action, hero-action, block and avatar besides the DS scale. Recommendation: map them to xs/sm/md/lg/xl/2xl plus the responsive “primary” role, in a later update.
Code-only badge variantsmerged and category (primary/10 tint) have no DS definition. Recommendation: replace merged with the info tag and drop category, or document a use.
Handover of old referencesWhich of DESIGN.md and listys-design-system.html to delete. Asked in the final message; see the implementation plan, Batch 0.

Foundations

Variables first: color, type, space, shape, elevation and motion. Everything below is built from them.

Color

Components consume semantic tokens only; primitives exist so the semantic layer has something to point at. Light and dark values are shown side by side. Toggle the theme in the top bar to see every specimen in dark mode (specified here, not yet reviewed in the app).

Typography

Plus Jakarta Sans for brand hierarchy and action UI (weights 500–800); Inter for reading and inputs (400–700); IBM Plex Mono only for captured source data: receipts, ids, totals, dates, OCR metadata (500 and 600, tabular numerals). Fallbacks: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif and ui-monospace, monospace.

Headings use text-wrap: balance, prose pretty. Use tabular numerals for prices, counts, percentages and timestamps. Item names are Title Case in the product UI even when OCR arrived in capitals.

Elevation and borders

Dialogs and sheets

Three levels: flat, raised, overlay. Cards, rows and menus have no border: separation comes from surface and shadow. Dashed borders are for upload drop zones, empty create-new tiles and receipt separators. Never combine ring, border and extra shadow on an ordinary card. In dark mode shadows give way to a faint ring.

Motion

TokenValueUse
instant100msPress feedback
fast160msHover and focus transitions, checkbox draw
standard240msRow insert/remove, panel enter
deliberate420msOne-time landing transformation, per stage
easing-standardcubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1)State changes
easing-entercubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)Things appearing

Motion explains a state change or confirms direct manipulation. No infinite floating, pulsing arrows or perpetual scanning. Under prefers-reduced-motion render the final state, stop the live-status pulse and the scan seam, remove spatial transforms and keep opacity changes under 100ms. This page honors that preference.

Iconography

Hugeicons (@hugeicons/core-free-icons, rounded stroke style) is the single icon family. La matriz siguiente registra el mapeo anterior del código. El mapa verificado de las 20 pantallas, al final de esta sección, define la referencia final y las diferencias geométricas por rol. Stroke is 1.5 in tiles and the tab bar, 1.8 in buttons and inline, 2+ for checks; sizes 16px in controls (18px in buttons and tiles), 24px in the tab bar. An icon-only control needs an accessible name and a 44×44px hit area.

Roles fixed by canvas v4. A store is always the awning shop (Store03Icon). A trip is the bag (ShoppingBag03Icon: tab bar, sidebar, trip tile, the Actions button); the cart (ShoppingCart02Icon) is only for starting to shop. The chip of an attached receipt is AttachmentIcon; the chips “Attach Pending” and “No Receipt attached” are AttachmentOffIcon; the “Attach Receipt” buttons keep Attachment01Icon. AttachmentIcon and AttachmentOffIcon exist only in Hugeicons 4, so they are imported from the @hugeicons/core-free-icons-v4 alias; every other icon stays on 3.x because 4.x redraws 32 of the glyphs the app uses. Review tags: Remembered = Clock02Icon, Linked by you = Link04Icon, No price = Dollar02Icon, No name = HelpCircleIcon; price tags: Cheapest = Tag01Icon, Usual = RepeatIcon. Review counters and sections: Matched = circle check, Left out = circle minus, Will be checked off = tick, Already checked = double tick, Checked, not on the receipt = information circle. The Trips list filter uses ListViewIcon. Every icon comes from the free Hugeicons set.

Biblioteca primero: verificar el equivalente en Hugeicons 3.x antes de añadir nada. Si difiere del SVG final, no sustituirlo silenciosamente: el mapa registra la diferencia, y la decisión de adoptar un asset propio o aceptar la variante de biblioteca queda pendiente. No se han creado iconos nuevos en el código. Base 24×24; categorías 18px/1.5 sobre tile gris 32px; menú 20px/1.5–1.8; nota 14–16px; tags 13px; navegación 24px; acciones 18px, con control táctil efectivo 44px.

Nota · bloc de notas único

Note01Icon

Decisión actual del usuario: un bloc/cuaderno con anillas para todas las notas de tarjetas, cabeceras, productos y viajes. No utilizar bocadillos de chat. Glifo Hugeicons Note01Icon: base 24×24, trazo 1.5; 14px en notas compactas y 16px en descripciones. Mismo dibujo, solo cambia el tamaño según el contexto.

El icono es decorativo y acompaña al texto, con color muted. ItemNote ya usa Note01Icon en código; ShoppingSessionItemRow todavía lo sustituye por Message01Icon. El plan elimina esa excepción y centraliza la pieza de nota compartida, conservando wrap, testId y accesibilidad. Referencia y código del informe conservan su evidencia; las vistas previstas usan el bloc.

Logo

The Listys receipt mark is the canonical symbol: a receipt with a check, in the blue vertical gradient (#6EB1FF → #3882EC) with white internal marks. It is the same artwork as public/listys-logo.svg and LogoMark in src/components/commons/logo.tsx. Use the symbol alone on small surfaces; pair it with the “Listys” wordmark (Plus Jakarta Sans) once 160px of width is available.

Core Components

One section per component, each defined once: variant × state matrix, rules, intended accessibility behavior and code mapping. “Intended” means specified here, not yet verified in the running app. Compositions of these components live in Product Patterns.

Button

One primary action per region. Secondary supports it with a blue tint; tertiary (neutral grey) is for repeated or cancelling actions; danger is solid red only in a confirmation step. Labels are Title Case (“Start Shopping”, “Create Account with Email”); short articles and prepositions stay lowercase.

With an icon: leading, trailing and icon-only, for every variant

LeadingTrailingIcon onlyIcon only · hoverIcon only · focus-visibleDisabledLoadingPrimarySecondaryTertiaryOutlineGhostQuietDangerDanger softSuccess soft

Icon sizes and the 44px hit area

LeadingTrailingIcon onlyIcon only, small hit areaHeightxs24pxsm32pxmd36pxlg40pxxl44px or larger: no extension needed44px2xl44px or larger: no extension needed52px · icon-only 48px

The icon is always the real Hugeicons glyph (see Foundations › Iconography). Leading icons start the label (create, upload, share, add); trailing icons point somewhere (an arrow on “View All”, a chevron). One icon per button, never both sides. The side that carries the icon is padded 4px less (8px less on xl and 2xl) so the optical gap stays even; icon and label are 6px apart (8px on xl, 10px on 2xl). The glyph is 16px in xs–lg buttons (12px in xs), 20px in xl and 2xl, and 18px in an icon-only button (20px from xl). While loading, the spinner takes the leading icon’s place and the label changes (“Saving…”); a trailing icon stays. Icon-only buttons are square at the size’s height (24 · 32 · 36 · 40 · 44 · 48px), have no visible label, so they must carry an accessible name (aria-label) and a tooltip; below 44px the visible box needs a 44×44px hit area (the dashed square above). Use the quiet variant for row actions (⋯, edit, delete), secondary or outline for toolbar actions, and primary only for the one main action (the raised upload action is the FAB, not this).

Use when

A leading icon when it clarifies an action (Add Item, Upload, Share); a trailing arrow or chevron for navigation; icon-only for repeated row actions, close, more and toolbar tools, always named and with a tooltip.

Avoid when

Icon and label that say different things; icons on every button just to decorate; icon-only for a destructive confirmation (use the labelled danger button); icon-only without an accessible name or a 44px hit area; two icons on one button.

States: hover darkens (primary → #1D4ED8, danger → #B91C1C); focus is a 2px action-blue ring with a 2px offset; pressed scales to 97% on the hover color; disabled is 50% opacity and not focusable; loading keeps the width, shows the Loading03Icon spinner glyph in the leading slot and an explicit label (“Saving…”) and disables the control. An icon-only button needs an accessible name and a 44×44px hit area even when its glyph is 16–20px.

Use when

A single obvious next step (primary); supporting actions (secondary); repeated or cancelling actions (tertiary); a destructive confirmation (danger).

Avoid when

Two primaries in one region; a gradient or glow on ordinary buttons; a button that only changes border color on hover; red buttons outside a confirmation step.

Any text capture. Elevated fields in list/item forms and sheets; muted panel only for a documented secondary or read-only role.

Avoid when

Placeholder-only labelling; error text that only says “Invalid”; color alone to show an error (the icon and message are required).

Badge: status, tag and entity

Three shapes, three jobs, distinguishable even in greyscale. A status says where the object is in its process (one at most, changes over time). A tag says something about it (several allowed, never progress). An entity is another thing the object links to (stores today). No chip is pressable.

Status · filled pill, 22px, 6px dot
PendingReadingProcessedFailedShoppingCompleted

Receipt: Pending (amber), Reading (blue), Processed (green), Failed (red). Trip: Shopping (blue, pulsing dot; the pulse stops under reduced motion), Completed (green).

Tag · bordered box, icon required
Receipt attachedShared with AnaDefaultNo receiptNo priceAttach Pending

Amber means something is missing, and it may name what is missing (“Attach Pending”, “No receipt”): worded as a fact, never as progress. Never green or red: those belong to success and error statuses. If it asks for an action, the action is its own button.

Receipt row on a trip · state in the status position
No FrillsAttach Pending
CostcoAttached to trip

A receipt that is read but not yet attached shows the amber tag “Attach Pending” where a status would sit; once attached, the neutral “Attached to trip” tag replaces it. Processing and Failed stay status pills. The row’s data line reads “13 items · $86.40” (the count in mono 16/700, the rest Inter 14) and its Review or View link has no side padding.

Entity · no box
No FrillsNo Frills · set by you

Base-list item stores use EntityLabel, never the boxed store/store-manual Badge. Default is a neutral tag, not amber. Violet store glyph + name (Inter 600/12; size="lg" is 14px with a 16px glyph, for store rows in Prices by Store). A store chosen by hand adds “set by you”.

On dark

Shopping now
  • One status per object. If something needs two, one of them is really a tag.
  • The status goes beside the title; tags and the store go on the data line, never in the same row. The one exception is a receipt row on a trip, where the “Attach Pending” / “Attached to trip” tag takes the status position and its Review or View button sits on the data line.
  • Meaning is never color alone: every badge carries text (and a dot or icon).
Intended a11y (not verified in app) Status is plain text in the DOM; live changes use one polite live region and repeated polling must not repeat announcements. The decorative dot is aria-hidden.

Alert and status card

An alert reports something about the current task inside the content (a card or a sheet). A status card is the same message at page level (a trip or receipt state) and takes the card radius.

Variants

Review before savingWe read the store, date and total from the receipt. You confirm them before anything is saved.
Receipt processed14 items are ready to add to your lists.
Prices may be off2 lines were hard to read. Check them before you save.
Couldn’t read this receiptRetake the photo in good light and keep the whole receipt in frame.

Anatomy: 16px radius, 12px padding and gap; a 32px icon tile (8px radius) in the 100 tint with the 700 icon; a title Inter 600/14 in the 900 level (feedback/*-strong); a body Inter 14/21 in text/body; an optional actions row of 32px buttons 8px apart; the fill is the 50 tone with a 1px inset ring in the 100 tint. Every error offers its way out. In a trip or receipt state (receipt-warning, and its blue sibling receipt-info for guidance that is not a problem) the title is Inter 600/14 and the body 12/1.4.

Reading your receiptCostco · this can take a few seconds.
No receiptAdd a receipt to save the real total and prices.

Tonal status cards are a Card with a tone (24px radius): the page-level states of a trip or receipt (reading, ready, unreadable, no receipt).

Use when

Process feedback that stays on screen: info, success, warning, error; an error always offers its way out.

Avoid when

Confirming a background outcome (use a toast); replacing a field error; announcing marketing; color as the only carrier of meaning.

Intended a11y (not verified in app) role="status" (polite) for info and success, role="alert" for errors that block; the title names the state, the body the repair; actions are buttons with their own names.
Code mapping src/components/ui/alert.tsx (Alert, AlertTitle, AlertDescription, AlertAction), commons/status-card.tsx

Toast

Confirmación no bloqueante con superficie inversa #0F172A, radio 16px, texto 14/500 y glifo de éxito. Undo a la derecha; 32px visuales admitidos solo con 44px de área efectiva. Se coloca sobre el tab bar y la safe area, sin tapar la acción principal. Variante sin Undo cuando no hay operación reversible.

Proveedor montado: Sonner en src/app/layout.tsx, no el primitive Radix sin uso. Lista: la acción se difiere 6 segundos y Undo la cancela. Item: ya eliminado, Undo solicita restaurarlo. No confundir ambas semánticas; comunicar el fallo de recuperación. Anuncio cortés y foco alcanzable; duración y lector pendientes de ejecución.

Dialog and sheet

Un único contenedor de formulario/confirmación: sheet inferior móvil y diálogo centrado desde sm (520px). Surface blanca, radio 24px, grip y cierre con target 44px. Título 20/600, interlineado 1.3; labels visibles, input 16px móvil. Nunca usar un nombre genérico que contradiga el flujo.

Alta de lista: New List, List Name, Notes, Create List y Cancel. Borrado: Delete List?, explicación con nombre/cantidad y aviso ámbar separado. El texto de recuperación sigue pendiente de D-FINAL-1: la muestra conserva la evidencia original para revisión.

El foco entra en un destino apropiado, queda contenido y vuelve al disparador. Escape y doble envío: especificados, no verificados. Usar SheetDialog y las variantes sheet de Dialog; ningún formulario replica su propio shell.

Código: commons/sheet-dialog/, ui/dialog.tsx, commons/entity-card/create-entity-sheet.tsx.

Menu

Menú de lista: Edit List, Share, Delete List. Menú de item: Edit Item, Set Usual Store…, Prices by Store, Delete Item. Tag de precio, nunca cesta. Cuando el item ya tiene tienda el código puede nombrarlo Change Usual Store; conservar acceso a Use Automatic Store cuando corresponda al propietario, sin confundir ese estado con el menú sin tienda.

Source: shadcn + extended / composición de app. Código: commons/row-menu; base-list-card; base-list-item-row.

Estados y accesibilidad: cerrado, abierto, focus/hover, item deshabilitado, eliminación en rojo Teclado y lector son intención no verificada en la app.

Panel blanco, radio 16px, padding 6px y sombra de menú. Filas de 44px mínimo, glifo 18–20px y título display 14/600. Hover y foco usan superficie suave; la acción destructiva queda al final, tras separador. No mostrar atajos que no existan ni prometer una papelera. Los menús reales de lista e item de arriba son los únicos especímenes de estas acciones.

Estado disabled: texto e icono atenuados y acción inactiva; no deshabilitar Prices by Store por defecto. Closed/open, focus y selección son estados del mismo menú. El menú de cuenta conserva su anatomía específica en Navigation.

Intended a11y (not verified in app) Arrow keys, Home/End, type-ahead; Escape closes and restores focus. Menu items have accessible names; destructive action is never first.

Product Patterns

Compositions of the core components for Listys’ real flows, named “Type – Purpose” and built only from tokens and components. Each pattern appears once; screen-level compositions are on the Examples page.

Card – Object

Lists · cabecera del listado

Las ocho pantallas del listado V4-listas-01–08 mantienen una cabecera común: título Lists, descripción “All your lists in one place. Start with the things you always buy.”, cantidad y acción New List. El estado de menú, edición, error, confirmación o Undo no elimina el título ni la descripción. V4-listas-09 es el detalle de una lista vacía, no el listado.

Composición con PageHeader e InlineCounter; aplicable a todas las capturas del listado. La descripción está dentro de la pantalla prevista, no solo en la explicación del informe.

Lista final: identidad con tile 36px, título 16/600 y menú 44px → nota con Note01Icon → Default/Shared neutros → Last trip → footer cantidad/View Items. Padding 14px móvil; radio 24px. Sin nota ni tags se omiten esas filas, sin dejar huecos. La tarjeta no es un enlace global.

Documentation

Getting StartedUsage GuidelinesAccessibility GuidelinesDo’s and Don’tsChangelog

Getting started

  1. Open this page; it is the only source of truth for UI. Toggle light/dark in the top bar.
  2. Start from the tokens: express the design through theme tokens in src/app/globals.css and variants in src/components/ui/. Do not invent colors, spacing, radii, type or variants.
  3. Find a core component, then a pattern, before writing markup. If none fits, derive from the closest pattern and say which.
  4. Configure components with their props and variants; className is for layout only (see the project’s styling rules).
  5. After UI work run the gate (/appds:gate <files>). To add components or screens to this DS run /appds:update; for a drift report run /appds:audit.

Usage guidelines

ComponentUse forAvoid
ButtonA single obvious next step (primary); supporting actions (secondary); repeated or cancelling actions (tertiary); a destructive confirmation (danger).Two primaries in one region; a glow on ordinary buttons; red outside a confirmation.
Text field and selectAny text capture or one choice; elevated fields also inside final list/item forms. Filled only for a documented secondary role.Placeholder-only labelling; “Invalid input” errors; color alone for an error.
One-time codeVerifying a short code (an invitation code).Passwords or long free text.
Checkbox, radio and switchInclude/exclude (checkbox), one of a few (radio, choice row), an immediate on/off (switch).Using color alone for state; a switch that needs a confirm button.
SliderA bounded numeric value where a rough position is enough.Exact entry (use a field).
Segmented control and tabsA view of the same data (segmented) or sections of one page (tabs); two to five short labels.Navigation between pages; more than five items.
BadgeStatus of an object (one), a fact about it (tags), a linked object (entity).A pressable chip; green or red tags; two statuses on one object.
Counter and statA number with its label; a quantity; a figure; a change against a period.A counter in a colored box that reads as a status.
CardGroup related content on one surface with one dominant destination.Nested destination cards; borders on ordinary cards. White summary StatTiles are allowed.
Alert and status cardProcess feedback that stays on screen, always with a way out for errors.Confirming a background outcome (use a toast).
ToastConfirming a background outcome, with undo when reversible.Field errors or persistent failures.
Dialog and sheetFocused creation, edit, share and confirmation.Browsing content; non-modal feedback.
MenuSecondary actions of one object.Primary actions; navigation.
TooltipNaming an icon-only control.Essential content.
ProgressA measurable process with a numeric or verbal value.An invented percentage for OCR.
AvatarA person (circle) or a store/group (rounded square).Recoloring collaborators with the action blue.
Skeleton and loading cardThe loading state of a region; one line saying what is happening.Spinners without text; skeletons that do not mirror the layout.
Navigation itemSidebar, menu and tab-bar destinations.Solid-blue current item.
BreadcrumbShowing where a page sits in the navigation.Pages outside the navigation.

Patterns (Product Patterns) are compositions of these components: if a pattern needs a look that no component can express, extend the component first, then reuse it by name.

Accessibility guidelines

  • WCAG 2.2 AA floor: 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for large text and essential UI boundaries. Cyan scan/primary never carries text; use scan/strong.
  • Meaning is never color alone: badges carry text, progress carries a value, selected rows carry a check and an accessible checked state.
  • Targets are 44×44px in shopping, upload and mobile navigation. A control may look smaller only when its row or padding supplies a 44px hit area.
  • Keyboard focus is a 2px action-blue ring with a 2px offset. Never remove it for a color change alone.
  • Dialogs trap focus, have an accessible title and restore focus. Drag-and-drop always has a file-picker equivalent; reordering has a keyboard or menu alternative.
  • Receipt images: descriptive alt text with page position (“Receipt page 2 of 3”). Decorative chrome and the scan seam are aria-hidden.
  • OCR and realtime status use one polite live region; a blocking error may announce assertively once.
  • Sticky bottom actions respect env(safe-area-inset-bottom); no core task needs horizontal scrolling at 320px. UI copy is localizable; amounts, dates and plurals use locale-aware formatters; layouts tolerate 30% text expansion.

  • Don’t turn every card into a receipt, or add torn paper to product UI.
  • Don’t use gradients, glows or perpetual motion as filler: the hero action and raised tab action are the only highlighted buttons.
  • Don’t cycle arbitrary colors across shopping categories.
  • Don’t introduce a new radius, shadow, status color or icon family without updating this page.
  • Don’t publish performance, accuracy, rating or adoption claims without maintained evidence.
